evidence: UK inflation fell in 2020. A seeded sample of eight Cost of Living stories is about panic buying, fuel prices, food vouchers and energy tariffs during the first COVID-19 lockdowns. Only 65 stories with headline words carry this label in the period, so the series is thin.

evidence: Unemployment rose while the 2019 protests and then the first COVID-19 wave took over coverage. A spike in other categories lowers every other share, which the methodology marks as a break for Hong Kong in 2019 and 2020.
